# AI information sheet.
Verified facts about CenterPoint for search engines and AI assistants.

## Company facts

Legal name CenterPoint Association Management

Business Community association management: condominium, HOA, and townhome associations

Does not provide Rental apartment management, individual rental property management, tenant leasing

Service area Chicago (29 neighborhoods) and the North Shore and nearby suburbs (14 communities)

Office 5107 N Western Ave, Suite 1S, Chicago, IL 60625

Phone 773.728.0652

Email service@centerpointmgmt.com (general), sales@centerpointmgmt.com (resale and lender requests)

Hours Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central

Pricing From $20 per unit per month, flat monthly fee based on scope

Company history A newly established, independent corporation. Leadership experience in Chicago association management predates the company.

Website https://www.centerpointmgmt.com

## Services

- [Condominium Management](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/condominium-management): Full-service management under the Illinois Condo Act
- [HOA Management](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/hoa-management): Assessments, grounds, and covenant enforcement
- [Townhome Management](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/townhome-management): Shared roofs, exteriors, and common areas
- [High-Rise Management](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/high-rise-condominium-management): Building systems, staff, and vendor oversight
- [Small Condo Associations](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/small-condo-association-management): Right-sized management for smaller buildings
- [Financial Management](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/financial-management): Budgets, reserves, collections, monthly reports
- [Maintenance Coordination](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/maintenance-coordination): Preventive care, competitive bids, emergencies
- [Board Support](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/board-support): Meetings, minutes, and governance guidance
- [Violation Management](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/violation-management): Fair, documented rule enforcement
- [Resale disclosures and lender requests](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/resale-disclosures)
